funding.name: SC WINS (SC Workforce Industry Needs Scholarship)
funding.provides: A statewide technical college scholarship that covers remaining tuition, fees and course-related expenses after all other scholarships or grants are applied.
funding.eligibility: South Carolina resident enrolled in an eligible program; meet one of: be employed, take a financial literacy course offered at the technical college, or complete 100 hours of voluntary time contributing to a nonprofit or public service organization. Not all programs eligible (for example, University Transfer AA/AS at York Tech).
funding.amount: Up to $5,000 per academic year after applying all other scholarships or grants (per the SC Technical College System page)
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA and the SC WINS requirements at your technical college; forms vary by college.
